title: Assigned work: the assignee and the people above them work on it; others view

steps.expect: It shows, read-only: "🔒 This enquiry is assigned to <MktExec> — <MktExec> and the people <MktExec> reports to work on it; you can view it." No Save, no Drop, no Quote button on the register.
steps.observed: Test BDM sees "🔒 This inquiry is assigned to Test MktExec — Test MktExec and the people Test MktExec reports to work on it; you can view it." — no Save, no Drop; no Quote button on the register row.

steps.do: [MktMgr] open it → make a quotation from it.
steps.expect: Allowed. The quotation is assigned to <MktExec>.
steps.observed: Test MktMgr (whom Test MktExec reports to) made Q-00001 from it ("Q-00001 created."); the quotation is assigned to Test MktExec.

steps.expect: Viewable; the next-step line says who works on it; no Submit / Edit / Revise / sending buttons. A forced edit is refused with the same words.
steps.observed: Viewable; the line reads "Still a draft. This quote is assigned to Test MktExec — Test MktExec and the people Test MktExec reports to work on it; you can view it."; no Submit / Edit / Revise / sending buttons. Typing /quote-edit?id=1 is refused: "This quote is assigned to Test MktExec — Test MktExec and the people Test MktExec reports to work on it; you can view it.".
Test MktExec has Edit and Submit on the draft and, once it was approved, "Revise (new rev)" — as usual.

steps.do: EDGE · Unassigned enquiry, or the assignee left the company.
steps.expect: The whole team works on it, as before.
steps.observed: Test BDM may Save and Quote both the unassigned enquiry (INQ-00002) and the one whose assignee has left (INQ-00003).
